results.title: Nachtschwarm
results.overview: When Deliah, who recently lost her brother, takes a shortcut through the woods with her closest friends on the way home after graduation, an argument breaks out, and she is left alone in the woods with her brother's camera—or so she believes. The only evidence she has left are the recordings on her camera.

results.title: What Unites Us
results.overview: In a city marked by hypocrisy and desire, Ana, an erratic young woman, crosses paths with a nun in a crisis of faith. Between the sacred and the carnal, their limits and beliefs are stretched to the breaking point, until reality is distorted and violence erupts as a desperate act of help.

results.title: Shanghai Daughter
results.overview: A Shanghai woman journeys alone to a rubber plantation in southwest China, where her late father was sent during the Cultural Revolution. As she searches for a mysterious woman, some strangers unexpectedly drift into her path.

results.title: Children of The Wicker Man
results.overview: Fifty years after The Wicker Man, director Robin Hardy’s lost papers resurface, prompting his sons Justin and Dominic to explore the legacy of the cult classic, and their father. Together, they uncover the truth behind Robin’s role in the film and confront the complexities of independent filmmaking, family, and myth.

results.title: I Got My Brother
results.overview: Jarrett Harper and his younger brother Baylon share raw memories of abuse in LA's foster system, their unshakeable bond tested when the elder takes violent revenge on their abuser and faces life behind bars.

results.title: The Coronation
results.overview: Two of Hollywood’s loneliest creatures form an unlikely bond.

results.title: A Heart as Willing
results.overview: Nieves runs a swimming pool with her son Martin. One summer, a biker falls for her. Things between them don’t seem to work out, until a filming crew arrives at the pool while scouting for locations and the director decides to put Natacha and the biker in her film.

results.title: Doubt
results.overview: A couple of months away from his ordination, young Catholic deacon Jean decides to briefly join a remote monastery in Luxembourg to decide whether he’s more suited to monastic life. His days are spent in prayer, ritual, choir practice, and quiet observation of the peaceful life there. However, the arrival of a visitor, an attractive young man who also happens to be a benefactor to the monastery, awakens unsettling feelings Jean struggles to identify. Soon, Jean is forced to confront his convictions, but also the very foundation of his sense of belonging.

results.title: Sublet
results.overview: When her housemate sublets their room for the week, Jess suddenly finds herself sharing a hallway with a complete stranger.

results.title: Cervantes Follies: A Documentary
results.original_title: La revista del Cervantes: El documental
results.overview: Through interviews with its creators, footage of rehearsals, and scenes from performances in the main auditorium of the Teatro Nacional Cervantes, the film chronicles the development of a show that pays tribute to a century-old Argentine musical tradition: La Revista.

results.title: Camino de Brujas
results.overview: After several failed attempts, Carolina finally becomes pregnant. She and her partner experience moments of happiness until a series of suicides begin among people close to them. This unearths a series of secrets involving her parents and a shadowy woman who appears in nightmares with the arrival of a new baby in the family.

results.title: Leila
results.overview: Set in a modern world, Leila follows the story of a young, introverted girl who stumbled upon a life-changing artificial intelligence assistant technology named 'Leila'. She grows overly fond of her new AI friend and gradually begins to lose touch of reality, leading to a series of unforeseen dark events.

results.title: Red Razor On Soft Skin
results.overview: A giallo horror film about Benny Lazar, a timid son forced by his mother Moira to get a shave and a haircut from a mysterious barber. What ensues is a Technicolor nightmare of love, hate, betrayal, and self-destruction.

results.title: Paul Mirabel - Par Amour
results.overview: "Par Amour" is the second stand-up show by comedian Paul Mirabel, succeding "Zèbre". The creation, writing and direction by the artist explore love in all its forms (romantic, family, friendly) and the passions that drive life, humor, mixing and sensitivity introspection

results.title: The Apex Predators Club
results.overview: On a remote island where the rich hunt monsters, the game flips when the hunters become prey. With savage beasts closing in and no escape, survival is the only rule. Welcome to The Apex Predators Club.
